correctness.rationale: The proof uses Mwesigye--Truss character recursion, the exact monochromatic linear-order threshold, and an explicit split lemma. Endpoint and interior cases yield thresholds \(2^q-1\) and \(2^q-2\) respectively. The standalone finite checker independently rebuilds recursive character sets and verifies ranks 1--4 across saturation boundaries.

value.rationale: The exactly-one-red family is a natural constrained class of finite coloured words. The result is a complete all-rank classification where the general coloured literature supplies recursive bounds, and it exposes a structural endpoint/interior one-unit threshold gap together with exact type counts and a sharp minimal-representative bound.
